svg.title: From published code to a finding that notices change
svg.desc: Four steps: the published repository is pinned at commit 92f0918; an exact span (home-mixer/params/param.rs line 347, with its SHA-256 and anchor) is read from the git blob; a finding cites that span and is reviewed by a different reviewer; at the newer commit ed78e06 the cited bytes are gone, so the finding becomes STALE and goes back to review.
